gloss: lack of exercise; insufficient physical activity

definitions.gloss: lack of exercise; insufficient physical activity
definitions.explanation: the state of not getting enough physical exercise or activity

examples.japanese: {運動不足|うんどうぶそく}で{太|ふと}ってしまった。
examples.english: I gained weight due to lack of exercise.

examples.japanese: {運動不足|うんどうぶそく}を{解消|かいしょう}するためにジムに{通|かよ}い{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started going to the gym to address my lack of exercise.

examples.japanese: デスクワークが{多|おお}いと{運動不足|うんどうぶそく}になりやすい。
examples.english: If you do a lot of desk work, you tend to lack exercise.

notes:
HEALTH VOCABULARY:
{運動不足|うんどうぶそく} is a common concern, especially for people with sedentary lifestyles.

HEALTH EFFECTS:
Lack of exercise can lead to:
- {肥満|ひまん} - obesity
- {生活習慣病|せいかつしゅうかんびょう} - lifestyle diseases
- {体力低下|たいりょくていか} - decline in physical strength
- {筋力低下|きんりょくていか} - muscle weakness

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運動不足|うんどうぶそく}を{解消|かいしょう}する - to address lack of exercise
- {運動不足|うんどうぶそく}になる - to become lacking in exercise
- {運動不足|うんどうぶそく}{気味|ぎみ} - somewhat lacking in exercise

SOLUTIONS:
- ジムに{通|かよ}う - go to the gym
- ウォーキング - walking
- ストレッチ - stretching
- {階段|かいだん}を{使|つか}う - use stairs

RELATED ~{不足|ぶそく} COMPOUNDS:
- {睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく} - lack of sleep
- {栄養不足|えいようぶそく} - nutritional deficiency
- {水分不足|すいぶんぶそく} - dehydration
